examples.solution_text:
(a) Evaluate the powers before subtracting.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}4^{3}-3^{2}\\&=64-9\\&=55\end{aligned}$
(b) Do the power, then multiply, then add.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}3\times4^{2}+5\\&=3\times16+5\\&=48+5\\&=53\end{aligned}$

(a) Work inside the brackets first. Inside them, do the power before adding.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}2(3+2^{3})\\&=2(3+8)\\&=2\times11\\&=22\end{aligned}$
(b) Subtract inside the brackets, then square the result. The $2$ outside means multiply by $2$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}2(8-3)^{2}\\&=2\times5^{2}\\&=2\times25\\&=50\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
A student evaluates $3^{2}+18\div3\times2$ as $9+18\div6=12$.
Explain the error and find the correct value.
examples.solution_text:
Division and multiplication have equal priority. Work from left to right, so divide $18$ by $3$ before multiplying by $2$.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}3^{2}+18\div3\times2\\&=9+18\div3\times2\\&=9+6\times2\\&=9+12\\&=21\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
Evaluate $\frac{5^{2}-7}{2^{3}-2}$.
Explain what the fraction bar groups.
examples.solution_text:
The fraction bar groups the whole numerator and the whole denominator. Work out each before dividing.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\frac{5^{2}-7}{2^{3}-2}\\&=\frac{25-7}{8-2}\\&=\frac{18}{6}\\&=3\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text:
(a) Evaluate $7+2\times4^{2}$ and $7+(2\times4)^{2}$.
(b) Insert one pair of brackets into $7+2\times4^{2}$ to make the value $144$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Without brackets, square $4$ before multiplying.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}7+2\times4^{2}\\&=7+2\times16\\&=7+32\\&=39\end{aligned}$
With brackets, multiply inside them before squaring.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}7+(2\times4)^{2}\\&=7+8^{2}\\&=7+64\\&=71\end{aligned}$
(b) Group $7+2$ so the addition happens first.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(7+2)\times4^{2}\\&=9\times16\\&=144\end{aligned}$

Evaluate the powers, then divide before subtracting.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}8^{2}-6^{3}\div4\\&=64-216\div4\\&=64-54\\&=10\end{aligned}$

Inside the brackets, multiply before adding. Then square the bracket's value.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(5+2\times4)^{2}\\&=(5+8)^{2}\\&=13^{2}\\&=169\end{aligned}$

Work out the power and addition inside the brackets, then the remaining power, multiplication and subtraction.
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}(3^{2}+2)\times4-5^{2}\\&=(9+2)\times4-5^{2}\\&=11\times4-5^{2}\\&=11\times4-25\\&=44-25\\&=19\end{aligned}$
